comments.author: daqwan.morris
comments.body: Preliminary log analysis shows repeated failed login attempts for user t.reynolds@summitlogistics.com from IP 185.199.108.153 (associated with Spokeo) starting 2024-03-27 22:10 UTC. The account was terminated on 2024-03-20 but remained active until 2024-03-28. This appears to have triggered the outage on the hr-payroll-02 server.

comments.author: rui.guo
comments.body: Network isolation of the HR payroll subnet completed at 2024-03-28 03:14 UTC. No atypical outbound traffic detected; firewall logs show no data exfiltration. Subsystem hr-payroll-02 is now quarantined.

description: On 2024-03-27, the HR payroll subsystem experienced an outage affecting ADP Workforce Now integration. Initial investigation pointed to authentication failures.
